canonical_question.en: Why do diseases increase during the rainy season?

en: Why am I getting sick in the rainy season?
Why is disease common when it rains?
What happens to water and disease in the rainy season?
shona: Sei vanhu vachiwanzorwara mumwaka wemvura?
Sei chirwere chichiwanda kana kuchinaya?
Mwaka wemvura unokanganisa sei chirwere nemvura?

answer_short.en: Rain can wash waste and germs into water sources, so disease spreads more easily.
answer_short.shona: Mvura yemvura inogona kugeza tsvina nemasimu ichiisa mumvura yekushandisa, saka chirwere chinopararira nyore.

en: Treat drinking water carefully during the rainy season.
Wash hands often with soap or ash.
Use a toilet and keep waste away from water.
shona: Rapai mvura yekunwa nokungwarira mumwaka wemvura.
Gezai maoko kazhinji nesipo kana madota.
Shandisai chimbuzi uye chengetai tsvina kure nemvura.

answer_warning.en: Be extra careful about water safety and handwashing during the rainy season.
answer_warning.shona: Ngwarirai zvikuru nyaya yemvura yakachengeteka nekugeza maoko mumwaka wemvura.

canonical_question.en: What should I do during a cholera outbreak?

en: Cholera outbreak advice.
How do I stay safe during cholera?
What should families do when cholera is spreading?
shona: Pane zano rei panguva yekorora?
Ndingazvidzivirira sei panguva yekorora?
Mhuri dzinofanira kuita sei kana korora ichipararira?

answer_short.en: During a cholera outbreak, only use safe water, wash hands often, and go quickly to a clinic for severe diarrhoea or vomiting.
answer_short.shona: Panguva yekorora, shandisai mvura yakachengeteka chete, gezai maoko kazhinji, uye endai kukiriniki nokukurumidza kana pane manyoka akanyanya kana kurutsa.

en: Drink only boiled or treated water.
Wash hands often with soap or ash and use a toilet.
Go to the nearest clinic immediately if someone has severe diarrhoea or vomiting.
shona: Inwai mvura yakabikwa kana yarapwa chete.
Gezai maoko kazhinji nesipo kana madota uye shandisai chimbuzi.
Endai kuchipatara chepedyo pakarepo kana munhu aine manyoka akanyanya kana kurutsa.

answer_warning.en: Cholera can kill quickly, so severe symptoms need urgent medical help.
answer_warning.shona: Korora inogona kuuraya nekukurumidza, saka zviratidzo zvakanyanya zvinoda rubatsiro rwechimbichimbi.

follow_up_question.en: Is anyone very sick right now?
follow_up_question.shona: Pane munhu ari kurwara zvakanyanya here pari zvino?

canonical_question.en: How can I protect myself from diseases?

en: How do I avoid getting sick?
What are disease prevention tips?
How can my family stay healthy?
shona: Ndingaita sei kuti ndisarware?
Ndeapi mazano ekudzivirira chirwere?
Mhuri yangu ingaramba sei iine utano?

answer_short.en: You can protect yourself by using safe water, washing hands, using a toilet, and keeping food and the home clean.
answer_short.shona: Munozvidzivirira nekushandisa mvura yakachengeteka, kugeza maoko, kushandisa chimbuzi, uye kuchengeta chikafu nemusha zvakachena.

en: Drink treated water.
Wash hands at key times and use a toilet.
Keep food covered and keep your surroundings clean.
shona: Inwai mvura yarapwa.
Gezai maoko panguva dzinokosha uye shandisai chimbuzi.
Fukidzai chikafu uye chengetai nharaunda yakachena.

answer_warning.en: Ignoring these habits puts your family at risk.
answer_warning.shona: Kurega kuita izvi kunoisa mhuri yenyu panjodzi.

canonical_question.en: What is diarrhoea and how do I treat it?

en: What causes diarrhoea?
How do I treat diarrhoea at home?
What should I do if I have diarrhoea?
shona: Chii chinokonzera manyoka?
Ndinorapa sei manyoka kumba?
Ndoita sei kana ndine manyoka?

answer_short.en: Diarrhoea is frequent loose stools caused by germs in food or water. Drink clean water and use oral rehydration salts if available.
answer_short.shona: Manyoka ndiwo kuenda kuimba kazhinji nekuda kwemasimu muchikafu kana mumvura. Inwai mvura yakachena uye shandisai oral rehydration salts kana iripo.

en: Drink only boiled or treated water.
Use oral rehydration salts (ORS) if available.
Go to a clinic if diarrhoea is severe or lasts more than two days.
shona: Inwai mvura yakabikwa kana yarapwa chete.
Shandisai oral rehydration salts (ORS) kana iripo.
Endai kuchipatara kana manyoka akanyanya kana akaramba mazuva maviri.

answer_warning.en: Diarrhoea in children can become dangerous quickly — seek help early.
answer_warning.shona: Manyoka muvana anogona kuva ane ngozi nekukurumidza — tsvagai rubatsiro nekukurumidza.

canonical_question.en: What is typhoid and how does it spread?

en: How do I get typhoid?
What are the signs of typhoid?
Can typhoid be prevented?
shona: Ndinowana sei typhoid?
Ndezvipi zviratidzo zvetyphoid?
Typhoid inogona kudzivirirwa here?

answer_short.en: Typhoid is a serious bacterial infection spread through contaminated water and food. It causes fever, stomach pain, and weakness.
answer_short.shona: Typhoid chirwere chakakomba chebhakitiriya chinopararira kuburikidza nemvura nechikafu zvine tsvina. Chinokonzera febha, kurwadziwa kwedumbu, uye kushaya simba.

en: Drink only treated water.
Wash hands before eating and after using the toilet.
Go to a clinic if you have a high fever lasting more than two days.
shona: Inwai mvura yarapwa chete.
Gezai maoko musati madya uye mushure mekushandisa chimbuzi.
Endai kuchipatara kana mune febha yakakwira inoramba mazuva maviri.

answer_warning.en: Typhoid needs medical treatment — do not try to treat it at home alone.
answer_warning.shona: Typhoid inoda kurapa kwechipatara — musaedza kuirapa kumba chete.

canonical_question.en: How can I prevent water contamination at home?

en: How do I keep stored water clean?
How do I stop water from getting dirty?
What is the right way to store water?
shona: Ndinochengeta sei mvura yechengeterwa yakachena?
Ndinomisa sei mvura kusvibiswa?
Nzira yakarurama yekuchengeta mvura ndeipi?

answer_short.en: Keep stored water covered, use a clean container with a lid, and never dip dirty hands or cups into stored water.
answer_short.shona: Chengetai mvura yechengeterwa yakafukidzwa, shandisai mudziyo wakachena une chipfeko, uye musambobatidza maoko kana kapu tsvina mumvura yechengeterwa.

en: Store water in a clean covered container.
Use a ladle or tap to pour water out — never dip hands in.
Keep the storage area clean and away from animals.
shona: Chengetai mvura mumudziyo wakachena une chipfeko.
Shandisai kapu kana chombo kutorera mvura — musambobatidza maoko.
Chengetai nzvimbo yekuchengeta yakachena uye kure nemhuka.

answer_warning.en: Dipping hands or dirty cups into stored water re-contaminates it even after boiling.
answer_warning.shona: Kubatidza maoko kana kapu tsvina mumvura yechengeterwa kunoisvibisa zvakare kunyange yakabikwa.

canonical_question.en: How do diseases spread in the community?

en: How do germs spread?
Why do so many people get sick at the same time?
What causes disease to spread?
shona: Masimu anopararira sei?
Sei vanhu vazhinji vachirwara panguva imwe chete?
Chii chinokonzera kupararira kwezvirwere?

answer_short.en: Diseases spread through contaminated water, unwashed hands, open defecation, flies, and contact with sick people or animals.
answer_short.shona: Zvirwere zinopararira kuburikidza nemvura ine tsvina, maoko asina kugezwa, kuzvibatsira panze, makonye, uye kubata vanhu kana mhuka dzirwara.

en: Use safe water and wash hands at key times.
Use a toilet every time and keep waste away from water.
Keep food covered and avoid contact with people who are very sick.
shona: Shandisai mvura yakachengeteka uye gezai maoko panguva dzinokosha.
Shandisai chimbuzi nguva dzose uye chengetai tsvina kure nemvura.
Fukidzai chikafu uye dziverenai kubata vanhu vari kurwara zvakanyanya.

answer_warning.en: Open defecation is one of the fastest ways to spread disease across a whole community.
answer_warning.shona: Kuzvibatsira panze ndiyo nzira imwe yekukurumidza kupararira kwezvirwere munharaunda yose.
